mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_mode ( user_id, event_name, start_date, end_date, is_leave_mode_enabled, budget_amount ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{eventName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{leaveModeEnabled}, #{budgetAmount} )
mapper.select: SELECT leave_mode_id, user_id, event_name, start_date, end_date, is_leave_mode_enabled, budget_amount FROM leave_mode WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_leave_mode_enabled = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND start_date <= #{referenceDate} AND end_date >= #{referenceDate} ORDER BY start_date DESC, leave_mode_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT leave_mode_id, user_id, event_name, start_date, end_date, is_leave_mode_enabled, budget_amount FROM leave_mode WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY start_date ASC, leave_mode_id ASC
